physical_time.role: the independent parameter of the sampled trajectories and the ONLY parameter for any later scientific temporal or trajectory-relational derivative

normalized_validation_time.role: EXISTS ONLY to specify the frozen calibration/evaluation block fractions; carries no scientific dimension

reason: discharge durations differ (3.780 - 5.360 s); differentiating with respect to tau would rescale derivative values differently across discharges and corrupt physical dimensions

why_coherent: validation windows are specified in normalized time tau, so the block fractions are cadence-independent
coefficients are discharge-specific under the frozen structural-transfer contract
method comparisons use identical support WITHIN a discharge
gate V7 requires common scored samples per discharge, not identical timestamps across discharges

source_supported_cadence_semantics.name: SOURCE-SUPPORTED AVERAGE CADENCE ESTIMATE
qualifications: support/count based, not a local sampling interval
nonuniform original sampling cannot be reconstructed from these metadata
it is the finest temporal resolution justified by the presently certified archival-input provenance for the purposes of this study
source_supported_cadence_semantics.defensible_claim: the primary analysis grid is no finer than the provenance-supported temporal-resolution estimate used by the frozen numerical-admissibility policy
claims_explicitly_NOT_made: every analysis sample is an observation
the grid recovers the exact native sampling of any diagnostic

upsample_count_semantics.criterion: upstream-upsampled in AT LEAST ONE discharge

historical_count_16.why_different: a median cannot detect a signal upsampled in only a minority of discharges; the two counts measure different things and are not contradictory
